correctness.rationale: For every d>=2, n>=1 and continuous zonal PSD f on S^d, if n<=d+1 embed {-1,1}^n/n^{1/2} in S^d: the full convolution Gram kernel f((epsilon·eta)/n) is PSD, so every Walsh Fourier coefficient is nonnegative. Taking independent ±1 signs of bias t converts the ordinary affine Bernstein sampling into sum_A hat h(A)t^{|A|}, hence nonnegative power coefficients and PSD by tensor kernels on every S^D. For n>=d+2 the normalized Gegenbauer polynomial Q_{n+2}^{(d)} is a valid PSD input; centered n-th finite differences yield a degree-n Gegenbauer coefficient equal to (n!/n^n) ((n+lambda)(d+1-n)/(3n))((n+1)(n+2)/((n+d-1)(n+d))), strictly negative. Schoenberg gives failure. Independently checked Walsh layers for small d,n and the exact Gegenbauer obstruction for 28 (d,n) pairs using symbolic rationals. The pre-existing S² positive slice and general negative direction are credited, not newly proved here.
